changelog.title: Rock Edition Onyx Production Release (Linux 4.14.357)

changes: Zero EL1 Aborts: Resolved Xiaomi Power HAL NodeLooperThread fatal panic by preserving sysctl_sched_migration_cost as writable in .data.
Storage I/O Optimization: Default UFS block storage scheduler tuned to zero-overhead noop for flash memory.
Motherboard Protection: Standard PC USB host ports clamped to 500mA USB 2.0 SDP to eliminate ADB disconnect loops and protect host motherboards.
Fast Charging: Full MediaTek Pump Express PE+ 2.0 dual-phase fast charging (up to 3.0A / 18W) on AC chargers.
KernelSU-Next legacy tip refresh with in-tree SUSFS v2.3.0 path/mount hiding and local SELinux hide backport.
Zero Frame-Drop Engine: Tuned energy-aware scheduler (EAS) and 240Hz gaming debounce.
Ported MediaTek VCU and V4L2 Codec2 hardware decoding/encoding engine from S vendor release.
